cited.quote: placed an order for the supply of 36 lakh packets of belt type of Sanitary Napkin

rationale: C2 shows a Health Department order for sanitary napkins from SHGs. That is a different product and buyer, not phenyl-type products purchased by local bodies. C1 covers SHG formation and seed funds only. No official step on SHG sanitary products bought by local bodies, so related activity only.

cited.quote: to carryout up-gradation and repair works in 860 Anganwadi Centres in

rationale: C1 and C2 describe constructing buildings for existing Anganwadi centres, modernisation and amenities; C3 sanctions upgradation and repair of 860 centres. None shows new centres being created or the total number increased. Related activity only.

cited.quote: A Venture Capital Fund will be created with a corpus of Rs. 500 cr., to support entrepreneurs
Entrepreneur Development programme is a poverty reduction programme

rationale: C4 (Industries GO, 2021) announces a general Rs. 500 cr. venture capital fund for sunrise-sector entrepreneurs, in future tense with guidelines to follow, not targeted at Adi Dravidar or tribal entrepreneurs. C1-C3 show subsidy and loan schemes (EDP, SEPY), not venture capital. Not started.

cited.quote: Financial Assistance for procurement of Agricultural Machinery and Equipment
subsidy assistance has been provided to farmers to the tune of Rs. 2.99 crore

rationale: C5 is a 2017-03-10 GO sanctioning financial assistance for procuring agricultural machinery under SMAM for 2016-17, after the government took office. C1 reports subsidy continuing in 2017-18 and proposed for 2018-19; C2 and C3 show it continuing to 2020-21. Continuation of the subsidy is shown.
